caption: The drawing depicts two rectangular metal buckles positioned side by side on a plain, light beige background. Both buckles have dark brown to bronze coloring with a slightly tarnished appearance. The left buckle is shown from the front, revealing a ribbed border with fine linear detailing along the edges and a central bar with two prongs extending toward the right. The right buckle is displayed at an angle, showing its depth and the inner mechanism, with raised edges, two parallel bars, and a set of prongs similar to the buckle on the left. The artist’s signature "Claude H. Marshall" appears at the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Buckles
